note: No challan discount or settlement scheme is in force in West Bengal — re-verified on 1 November 2026 against www.wbtrafficpolice.com, which loaded and shows only standing 'Online Fine Payment' and 'Compounding of traffic offences' links with no discount, concession or amnesty notice (Kolkata Traffic Police has run such a scheme before, a one-time fine settlement in Dec 2018-Feb 2019, but nothing current is in force). The official echallan.parivahan.gov.in portal and transport.wb.gov.in again returned HTTP 503 on 1 November 2026 and could not be fetched this cycle. A supplementary press search the same day found no new scheme announced by the West Bengal transport department or Kolkata/state traffic police. Discounts here come only through National Lok Adalat sittings, where the bench decides each case individually. Check and pay challans at the full amount on the official e-challan portal.
